requirements.custom_promisify_property: may be present or dynamically observable

target.notes: The runtime must perform symbol-aware property lookup and return the custom function itself when valid.

semantics.custom_present: promisify returns the custom function rather than wrapping the original
semantics.dynamic_lookup: normal JS property/proxy semantics may be observable

caveats: Do not erase the custom symbol during AOT lowering.

tests.name: normal custom function identity
tests.input: function f(){}; const c=()=>Promise.resolve(1); f[promisify.custom]=c; console.log(promisify(f)===c);
